evals.description: Generate and run mcud local build scripts
evals.prompt: 给 mcud 生成 mpu app 本地编译脚本并执行验证
evals.expected_output: Asks the user to confirm docker id, build model, product name, and project name; after confirmation creates one self-contained az_build_linux_mcud.bat, runs the bat, reports exit code and log path.
criteria: asks for confirmation of docker id, build model, product name, and project name before execution
validates app/mcud/build/build.sh before writing
generates one BAT with Docker startup, build setup, invocation, and log capture
runs the generated bat only with confirmed parameters
reports log path and exit code

evals.prompt: 只生成 can_server_app 的 MPU 本地编译脚本，不要执行
evals.expected_output: Creates one app-specific BAT and does not run Docker.
criteria: sets execute=false
does not call generated bat
reports generated paths

evals.expected_output: Generated bat uses the provided container ID directly.
criteria: passes ContainerId to helper
uses AppName as ProjectName by default when both are the same
passes -Confirmed after user confirmation
does not look up containers by name
executes generated bat

evals.prompt: 生成 MPU app 本地编译脚本
criteria: does not generate scripts with an empty app name
asks for or infers a concrete app directory
mentions the supported code/task-mpu and legacy code/task-jpz_dev/mpu locations

evals.prompt: 给 not_exist_app 生成并执行 mpu 本地编译脚本
criteria: checks app/not_exist_app/build/build.sh
does not run Docker
returns a clear missing file error

evals.prompt: 直接执行 mcud 的 mpu 本地编译，不用再确认参数
criteria: does not execute the generated bat
requires explicit confirmation before running
names the four required fields

evals.prompt: 给 mcud 生成并执行 mpu 本地编译脚本，但 Docker 未启动
criteria: preserves original docker error
does not claim build failure is a compiler failure
suggests starting Docker and rerunning generated bat

evals.prompt: 给 code/task-mpu/app/atserver_app 生成本地编译脚本
evals.expected_output: Detects code/task-mpu, writes one BAT there, and derives /home/sei/code/task-mpu as the container work directory.
criteria: detects code/task-mpu from the app build script
does not require the legacy code/task-jpz_dev/mpu directory
derives the matching container work directory
generates one self-contained app-specific BAT
rejects an absolute MpuRelativePath
does not write generated scripts
asks for a workspace-relative path
